entities.summary: Eliza Ann Ashton was an English-born Australian journalist and social reformer. She wrote for The Sydney Morning Herald and The Daily Telegraph under the names Faustine and Mrs Julian Ashton. She was a founding member of the Womanhood Suffrage League of New South Wales.
